# `schema-unsupported-keywords`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

Composition keywords are unevenly supported across agents and model tool mappers.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option     | Default   |
| ---------- | --------- |
| `keywords` | see below |

<details>
<summary><code>keywords</code> default</summary>

```json
[
  "$ref",
  "allOf",
  "oneOf",
  "anyOf",
  "not",
  "patternProperties",
  "if",
  "then",
  "else",
  "dependentSchemas"
]
```

</details>

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-unsupported-keywords": false } });          // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-unsupported-keywords": "warning" } });      // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-unsupported-keywords": { keywords: /* see the table above */ } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule schema-unsupported-keywords=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/schema-unsupported-keywords": "error" } }
```
